meals.title: Paprika Pork Braai Chops with Braaibroodjies
meals.why: PnP Pork Braai Chops are on special at R59.99, and a paprika rub with toasted cheese-and-tomato sandwiches stretches them into a full braai dinner.
method: Rub the chops with paprika, salt, pepper and a little oil, then rest for 15 minutes while the coals burn down.
Make sandwiches with cheese, sliced tomato and onion, and butter the outsides with the spread.
Braai the chops over medium coals for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through and the fat is crisp.
Toast the sandwiches in a braai grid until golden and the cheese has melted.
Rest the chops for 5 minutes and serve with the braaibroodjies and chutney.

meals.title: Butternut & Tomato Curry with Rice
meals.why: Butternut is only R14.99/kg at Checkers and combines with canned tomatoes and cheap parboiled rice for a filling vegetarian meal.
method: Fry a chopped onion and garlic in oil until soft, then stir in 2 tbsp curry powder for a minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cubed butternut with a splash of water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and cook for 5-10 minutes until the butternut is tender.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Serve the curry over rice with a spoonful of plain yoghurt on top.

meals.title: Tuna & Egg Fried Rice
meals.why: A 30-minute dinner built on R17 tuna, eggs and cheap parboiled rice.

uses.item: No Name Live Well Shredded Tuna in Salt Water

method: Cook the rice until just tender, drain and spread it out to steam dry.
Fry the onion and garlic in a hot wok or large pan, then add the veg for 2-3 minutes.
Push everything aside, scramble 3-4 eggs in the pan and break them up.
Add the rice, drained tuna and a splash of soy sauce, then toss over high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Taste, adjust the seasoning and serve hot.

meals.title: One-Pan Oven Paprika Chicken & Tomato Rice
meals.why: The 2kg frozen braai pack is R66.67, and the chicken bakes on top of rice in tomato sauce so you only wash one dish.

uses.item: No Name Frozen Chicken Braai Pack

method: Thaw the chicken fully in the fridge beforehand and heat the oven to 200°C.
Mix the rice, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, chopped onion, garlic, stock cube and 2 cups of boiling water in a deep baking dish.
Rub the chicken pieces with oil, paprika, salt and pepper and arrange them on top of the rice.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for 30-35 minutes until the chicken is golden and the rice is cooked.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

meals.title: Sheet-Pan Boerewors, Chips & Baked Beans
meals.why: Checkers Boerewors is R99.99/kg (R89.99 with loyalty), and this kid-friendly meal needs only a tray, a pot and cheap frozen chips and beans.

uses.item: Rhodes Quality Baked Beans In Tomato Sauce

method: Heat the oven to 220°C and spread the fries on a large tray.
Coil the boerewors on a second tray or push the fries to one side and add the wors to the same tray.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, turning the wors once, until browned and cooked through.
Warm the baked beans in a small pot.
Slice the wors and serve with the chips, beans and a little mustard or chutney.

meals.title: Butternut-Topped Cottage Pie
meals.why: Lean beef mince is R109.99/kg (R99.99 with loyalty), and cheap butternut mashed with milk makes a topping that goes further than potato.
method: Boil or steam the cubed butternut until soft, then mash it with a splash of milk, salt and pepper.
Brown the mince with chopped onion, carrot and garlic, then stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, herbs and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer the mince for 20 minutes until thick, and heat the oven to 190°C.
Spoon the mince into a baking dish and spread the butternut mash over the top, roughing it up with a fork.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the top is golden and the edges are bubbling.
